questions.question: A list of numbers is shown: -3/4, 0.6, -1.5, 5/2. Select the order of these numbers from least to greatest. Which ordering is correct?
questions.explanation: Convert all to decimals: -3/4 = -0.75, 0.6 = 0.6, -1.5 = -1.5, 5/2 = 2.5. From least to greatest: -1.5, -0.75, 0.6, 2.5. Verify by number line position: -1.5 is farthest left, then -0.75, then 0.6, then 2.5 farthest right.

questions.question: The temperature at dawn was -8 degrees F. By noon it rose to 5 degrees F. Part A: How many degrees did the temperature rise? Part B: Which expression represents the change?
questions.explanation: The change is the ending value minus the starting value: 5 - (-8) = 5 + 8 = 13 degrees. Verify on a number line: from -8 to 0 is 8 units, from 0 to 5 is 5 units, total 13 units up. Part A = 13, Part B = 5 - (-8).

questions.question: A grocery store sells a 12-ounce box of cereal for $3.60 and a 20-ounce box of the same cereal for $5.40. Which statement is true?

choices.A: The 12-ounce box has a lower unit price.
choices.B: The 20-ounce box has a lower unit price.
choices.C: Both boxes have the same unit price.
choices.D: The unit price cannot be compared.

questions.explanation: Unit price = price divided by ounces. 12-oz: $3.60 / 12 = $0.30 per ounce. 20-oz: $5.40 / 20 = $0.27 per ounce. Verify: 12 x 0.30 = 3.60, 20 x 0.27 = 5.40. The 20-ounce box ($0.27/oz) is cheaper per ounce than the 12-ounce box ($0.30/oz).

questions.question: In a parking lot, the ratio of cars to trucks is 5 to 2. If there are 35 cars in the lot, how many trucks are there?
questions.explanation: The ratio cars:trucks = 5:2. To scale 5 cars up to 35 cars, multiply by 7 (since 5 x 7 = 35). Apply the same factor to trucks: 2 x 7 = 14 trucks. Verify the ratio: 35:14 simplifies by dividing both by 7 to 5:2.

questions.question: A jacket originally costs $80. It is on sale for 25% off. What is the sale price of the jacket?
questions.explanation: 25% of $80 = 0.25 x 80 = $20 discount. Sale price = $80 - $20 = $60. Verify a different way: paying 75% of the price, 0.75 x 80 = $60.

questions.question: Select all values of x from the set {-2, 0, 3, 5, 8} that make the inequality 2x - 1 > 5 true. (Choose all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Solve 2x - 1 > 5: add 1 to both sides, 2x > 6, divide by 2, x > 3. So values strictly greater than 3 work: 5 and 8. Verify by substitution: x=5 gives 2(5)-1=9>5 true; x=8 gives 15>5 true; x=3 gives 5>5 false; x=0 gives -1>5 false; x=-2 gives -5>5 false.

questions.question: Evaluate the expression 3x squared - 4y when x = 2 and y = 5.
questions.explanation: Substitute and apply order of operations: 3(2)^2 - 4(5). First exponent: 2^2 = 4. Then 3 x 4 = 12 and 4 x 5 = 20. So 12 - 20 = -8. Verify: exponent before multiplication, multiplication before subtraction, giving 12 - 20 = -8.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to 4(2x + 3)?
questions.explanation: Apply the distributive property: 4(2x + 3) = 4(2x) + 4(3) = 8x + 12. Verify by testing x = 1: original 4(2+3) = 4(5) = 20; 8(1) + 12 = 20. They match.

questions.question: Solve the equation x + 14 = 9. Part A: What is the value of x? Part B: Which operation isolates x?

choices.A: Part A: x = 23 | Part B: add 14 to both sides
choices.B: Part A: x = 5 | Part B: subtract 14 from both sides
choices.C: Part A: x = -5 | Part B: subtract 14 from both sides
choices.D: Part A: x = -23 | Part B: subtract 14 from both sides

questions.explanation: To isolate x, subtract 14 from both sides: x = 9 - 14 = -5. Verify by substitution: -5 + 14 = 9, which matches the equation. Part A = -5, Part B = subtract 14 from both sides.

questions.question: Point A is located at (-3, 4) on the coordinate plane. Point B is the reflection of point A across the x-axis. What are the coordinates of point B?
questions.explanation: Reflecting across the x-axis keeps the x-coordinate and negates the y-coordinate. So (-3, 4) becomes (-3, -4). Verify: the x-axis is the line of reflection when two points have opposite y-coordinates; -3 stays, 4 becomes -4.

questions.question: A triangle has a base of 12 centimeters and a height of 7 centimeters. What is the area of the triangle?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = (1/2) x base x height = (1/2) x 12 x 7 = (1/2) x 84 = 42 square centimeters. Verify: the triangle is half of a 12 x 7 = 84 rectangle, so 84 / 2 = 42.

questions.question: A right rectangular prism has a length of 5 inches, a width of 3 inches, and a height of 4 inches. What is the volume of the prism?
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 5 x 3 x 4 = 60 cubic inches. Verify by layering: each layer is 5 x 3 = 15 cubic units, and 4 layers give 15 x 4 = 60.

questions.question: A data set of test scores is: 78, 85, 90, 85, 92. What is the median of the data set?
questions.explanation: Order the values: 78, 85, 85, 90, 92. With 5 values, the median is the middle (3rd) value, which is 85. Verify: two values below (78, 85) and two above (90, 92) the middle 85.

questions.question: A box plot of daily high temperatures shows: minimum = 60, lower quartile = 68, median = 74, upper quartile = 80, maximum = 88. Part A: What is the interquartile range (IQR)? Part B: What is the range?
questions.explanation: IQR = upper quartile - lower quartile = 80 - 68 = 12. Range = maximum - minimum = 88 - 60 = 28. Verify: IQR measures the middle 50% spread (12), range measures full spread (28). Part A = 12, Part B = 28.
